stories.title: Traffic Alert: Lanes reopening on I-985 NB in Gwinnett County after crash
stories.summary: Details are limited at this time.

stories.title: Eminent domain lawyer says new I-285 Express Lanes could affect hundreds of properties
stories.summary: GDOT says it tries to minimize impacts to property owners and follows all state and federal process for land acquisition.

stories.title: Family of 4 displaced, father taken to hospital after house fire in Cobb County
stories.summary: Fire officials said they believe it started outside the home.

stories.title: Head-on collision leaves 2 dead in Douglas County
stories.summary: GA-5 was closed for several hours while the crash scene was under investigation.

stories.title: Family seeks answers months after man is struck and killed on Downtown Connector
stories.summary: His family says his phone died, and police later found him dead on the highway. Raines' family shared photos of him, along with several posts they say he made.

stories.title: 2 East Coweta High School students killed in crash following brief police pursuit identified
stories.summary: Both teenagers were passengers in a vehicle that crashed off Highway 29 in Coweta County

stories.title: DeKalb Co. Schools devise plan after bats were found at Druid Hills High
stories.summary: School officials said neither students nor staff had contact with the bats.

stories.title: Cedartown officer who shot, killed HeeHaw the donkey officially reinstated, records show
stories.summary: The officer was deemed to have had the legal right to enter the pasture and protect himself from what he perceived as a threat.

stories.title: Atlanta considers new surveillance technology framework to increase oversight on police camera network
stories.summary: The proposed framework would increase oversight of Atlanta's extensive camera network and establish guidelines for future technology purchases.

stories.title: Medical examiner rules death of man ejected from Six Flags Goliath roller coaster an accident
stories.summary: Hassan Kariem, 42, died from blunt force injuries after he was ejected from Goliath and fell onto a roof. The medical examiner ruled his death an accident.

stories.title: Metro Atlanta woman dead after boyfriend kills her in Cumming: authorities
stories.summary: Authorities said a woman was killed inside an apartment. A suspect is in custody, and two children in the home were not hurt, police said.

stories.title: Driver charged with DUI after source says pregnant OBGYN doctor hit in crosswalk near Carrollton medical center
stories.summary: She sustained head injuries and was rushed to an Atlanta-area hospital for medical treatment.
